items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Charlie DuPont played, uh, trumpet. That's Ronnie DuPont's father.

ctx.x: Charlie DuPont played, uh, trumpet. That's Ronnie DuPont's father. Yeah.
But I, uh, I have seen him play bass.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I held him in my arms when he was a baby and took him in my arms the other night.

ctx.x: The fast as they put the blood in him, it poured out of him. It was pitiful. And Charlie DuPont and I, Charlie DuPont can tell you. Mm-hmm. Now Charlie DuPont and I played together on and off since 1927. That's Ronnie's daddy. Yeah, I know him. He played my wedding. So Ronnie not long ago and called me Unk. I held him in my arms. That's Al H. I was a great pianist. Ronnie DuPont. I held him in my arms when he was a baby and took him in my arms the other night. He was playing with Jimmy Ile. I think that he will…
Well, he's so good to me that I don't care who he's playing with, he's still Ronnie.
